active_continuity: Jin Taekyung has acquired the Myriad-Poison Ring, completing its chain Quest.
Tang Sadok revealed the Myriad-Poison Ring as the Sichuan Tang Clan's sacred artifact and handed it to Taekyung.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and critically ill with Formless Ultimate Poison.
The Divine Physician's treatment preparations are nearly complete, and he says the ring makes treatment possible within fifteen days.
Taekyung, Cheongpung, Dong Feng, and Mungyeong are currently at the Sichuan Tang Clan.
Tang Sadok and the Green Shadow Squad continue pursuing the one-armed killer responsible for Tang Taesang's murder and the Mount Emei massacre.
The killer is an exceptionally powerful martial artist comparable to the Ten Kings who has evaded the Tang Clan and Emei Sect.
Taekyung has promised to pursue and capture or kill the culprit if the killer flees while Jeok Cheongang is being treated.
Venerable Myoryeong remains under treatment for the Black Hand Seal.
open_questions: Will the Divine Physician's fifteen-day treatment save Jeok Cheongang?
Who is the one-armed killer, and can Tang Sadok's forces capture him?
Will Venerable Myoryeong fully recover from the Black Hand Seal?
temporary_decisions: Render 활신대법 as Life-Restoring Great Technique.
